Core UI/UX & Search-Optimized Engineering Pillars

Pillar 01 · Semantic DOM

Semantic HTML5 & Heading Taxonomy

Strict single-<h1> architecture per document with logical <h2> and <h3> subsections inside <header>, <nav>, <main>, <article>, and <footer> landmarks.

Pillar 02 · Metadata & Schema

Meta Tags, Open Graph & JSON-LD

Optimized 55–65 character title tags, 150–158 character meta descriptions, self-referencing canonical URLs, Open Graph social cards, and Schema.org JSON-LD.

Pillar 03 · Core Web Vitals

Zero-CLS Media & Accessible Alt Text

Every image declares explicit width, height, and descriptive keyword-grounded alt attributes so screen readers and search bots index visual content.

Frequently Asked Questions (Backed by FAQPage JSON-LD)

How does UI/UX design directly improve On-Page SEO rankings?

Search engines evaluate page experience signals alongside keyword relevance. Clean visual hierarchy, mobile responsiveness, fast Largest Contentful Paint (LCP < 1.8s), and descriptive anchor text increase dwell time and crawl depth.

Which structured data schemas are implemented across PixelForge Studio?

We implement validated JSON-LD scripts for EducationalOrganization, FAQPage, ItemList, and BreadcrumbList so Google Search generates rich snippets automatically.

Page 2 (projects.html) · Empirical HCI Case Studies

Human-Centered Design Systems & Usability Case Studies

Each case study combines Fitts's Law target sizing, Hick's Law navigation reduction, and semantic HTML5 structuring to maximize user task completion and organic search visibility.

FinTech · WCAG 2.2 AAA

FinPulse Accessible Banking App

Redesigned multi-step UPI payment flows using high-contrast semantic tokens and ARIA live regions, cutting checkout drop-off by 38% and boosting mobile Lighthouse SEO to 100.

SEO Impact: +64% organic impressions via SoftwareApplication schema
Campus HCI · Spatial UI

IIIT Nagpur AR Campus Wayfinding

Developed a progressive web directory for academic blocks, labs, and hostels with semantic breadcrumb trails, URL slug optimization, and instant offline caching.

SEO Impact: 0.9s Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) & 100% indexation
Gaming Tech · CSH Specialization

Chronos Esports Telemetry HUD

Created a color-blindness-safe (Deuteranopia/Protanopia) telemetry dashboard with semantic SVG charts and zero-layout-shift responsive containers.

SEO Impact: 0.00 CLS & 38ms Interaction to Next Paint (INP)
